# Vesharo Technologies

> Custom Software Engineering, IT Consulting, and Product Studio headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, delivering high-impact technology solutions globally.

## About Vesharo
Vesharo is a software engineering and IT consulting company founded and operated by senior engineers. We partner with product teams, venture-backed startups, and growing enterprises across the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, and India.

We operate across three complementary tracks:
1. **IT Consulting & Architecture Advisory**: Cloud FinOps, legacy strangler-pattern modernization, technical due diligence for investors/CTOs, security gap assessments (SOC2, HIPAA, OWASP), and fractional CTO advisory.
2. **Custom Software Engineering**: Full-stack web platforms, cross-platform and native mobile apps (iOS & Android), cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), data pipelines, and AI/LLM production integrations.
3. **Product-Based Work & Labs**: In-house proprietary SaaS products and enterprise accelerators (CoreFlow, CloudPulse, LaunchEngine, DocuMind AI).

## Core Guarantees & Credibility
- **100% Code & IP Ownership**: Code, database schemas, infrastructure-as-code, and cloud accounts are pushed directly to client repositories under client ownership from day one.
- **Fixed-Scope Pricing**: Every sprint or milestone is scoped and priced with zero hidden drift.
- **Senior Engineers Only**: Projects are architected and actively coded by senior engineers, never handed down to unvetted juniors or outsourced intermediaries.
- **NDA First**: Mutual non-disclosure agreements signed before receiving proprietary requirements or inspecting codebases.

## Offerings

### Custom Engineering Services
- **Custom Web Applications**: Composable web applications built with React, Next.js, Astro, Node.js, Go, and Python.
- **Mobile App Development**: High-performance mobile apps for iOS and Android using React Native and Flutter with offline-first synchronization.
- **Cloud Engineering & DevOps**: Multi-region architecture, Kubernetes orchestration, Docker, automated CI/CD pipelines, and zero-downtime deployments.
- **Enterprise Modernization**: Phased strangler-fig pattern migrations replacing legacy monoliths while preserving live transaction flows.
- **Data & AI Solutions**: Production-ready ETL pipelines, real-time analytics warehouses, and private enterprise RAG / vector retrieval systems.
- **Product & UI/UX Design**: Tokenized design systems, user journey mapping, and WCAG 2.1 AA accessible interfaces.

### Strategic IT Consulting
- **Cloud Architecture & FinOps Strategy**: Infrastructure right-sizing, cost attribution, and multi-cloud resilience (typically saving 25–40% in waste).
- **Legacy Modernization Advisory**: Architectural dependency mapping, risk registers, and coexistence gateways.
- **Technical Due Diligence & Code Audits**: Comprehensive pre-funding or acquisition audits evaluating code maintainability, security vulnerabilities, and licensing compliance.
- **Fractional CTO & Systems Advisory**: Strategic guidance on technology choices, team hiring scorecards, and deployment standards.

### In-House Products & Accelerators (Vesharo Labs)
- **Vesharo CoreFlow**: High-concurrency distributed event broker & webhook orchestration engine with zero-loss dead-letter recovery.
- **Vesharo CloudPulse**: Multi-cloud FinOps observability dashboard monitoring Kubernetes pod cost attribution and resource waste.
- **Vesharo LaunchEngine**: Battle-tested full-stack SaaS foundation with enterprise multi-tenancy, RBAC, SSO/SAML, and Stripe billing.
- **Vesharo DocuMind AI**: Private enterprise document intelligence and semantic search engine with strict VPC data isolation.

## Engagement & Pricing Models
- **Discovery & Architecture Sprint**: Starting from $5,900. Two-week architectural blueprint, clickable wireframe, schema definitions, and fixed-cost delivery roadmap.
- **Dedicated Engineering Pod**: Starting from $9,500/month. Senior full-stack engineering pod integrated into two-week agile sprint cadences.
- **Enterprise Modernization & Custom Build**: Scope-based pricing for large-scale transformations with a named delivery owner.
